name: Sign in, update a profile, and keep it after reload
description: Verifies authenticated users can create and retain their own display name.
steps: Confirm the site's 18+ check in the test browser
Open Log in and complete sign-in with a test account
Open Account, set the display name to FirstD Tester, and save
Reload the page, reopen Account, and check the display name
expected: FirstD Tester appears in the profile after the reload and the account remains signed in.

name: Submit a report and see it in account history
setup: Sign in with a test account
description: Verifies a listing report is stored and remains visible to its submitting account.
steps: Open a listing and choose Report this listing
Select a reason and enter a short test detail
Submit the report, then open Account
expected: The report appears in My reports after submission and still appears after reload.

name: Keep reports isolated between accounts
description: Verifies a different signed-in account cannot see another user's reports.
steps: Actor A signs in and submits a report for a listing
Actor B signs in with a different test account and opens Account
expected: Actor B's My reports list does not contain Actor A's report.

name: Block anonymous reports and preserve discovery search
description: Verifies discovery still works and report persistence requires an authenticated account.
steps: Confirm the site's 18+ check in the test browser
Search for water and verify one listing appears
Sign out, open a listing, and choose Report this listing
Try to submit a report without signing in
expected: Search shows the matching listing; anonymous report submission is not sent and the user is prompted to sign in.
